messages:
anna: Async standup — kernel / batching / KV perf. What I did: landed KV eviction fix in canary and ran a short mini-bench (PR #4123). Blocker: seeing a p99 tail latency bump on long sequences after warmup. Today: dig into slot allocation and follow up CRs.

mike: Nice, saw the canary. Quick q — eviction threshold was changed?

anna: yep, lowered from 0.75 -> 0.6 in the canary. change is in `runtime/config/kv.toml` (see PR 4123).

sasha: I ran same workload on a dedicated pool and didn't reproduce the p99 spike. Could be scheduler differences. Can you paste the perf log lines?

anna: snippet from the bench log (shortened):
```
# tail -n 200 /var/log/runtime/bench.log
00:10 time_total p50 p95 p99
00:10 12ms 45ms 220ms
00:11 13ms 48ms 230ms
00:12 11ms 46ms 410ms  <-- spike after warmup
```

lin: Could be slot steal during GC or reclaim. @mike @beth did we change slot-reclaim timing in last deploy?

mike: Not in prod — only pushed in canary branch `slot-reclaim-tuning`. I can revert if that helps.

beth: I can run an alternate with `idle_hold` bumped to 300ms and rebench, will report back in ~30m.

sasha: also noticed batching variance: microbatch window sometimes collapses to size=1 on tails. Suggest we emit a histogram metric of effective batch sizes so we can see distribution.

anna: good idea. I'll add `metric: batch.effective_size` with a `sequence_len_bin` tag and spike an alert if p95 of batch size < 2 for >1m.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment 2026-03-20T09:12:00Z -> slot-reclaim-tuning applied to pool-id: gpu-pool-7 :rocket:

lin: FYI I'm triaging a related prefetched-KV crash under high concurrency; opened issue #789 with logs.

anna: current blocker: need to decide whether to freeze the canary. Action item: @mike either revert reclaim changes or toggle reclaim off, otherwise I'll rollback the canary at EOD.

mike: I'll add a deploy toggle `runtime.slot_reclaim_enabled=false` for the canary via infra change (see infra PR 4130).

beth: if you want numbers fast I can post the 30m bench results here once complete. ping me.

anna: thanks all — I'll follow up in the PR comments and paste updated bench graphs here. No other blockers from me. :thumbsup:
